Family dining in Hongdae, Hapjeong and Sangsu

For a family meal in Hongdae, Hapjeong or Sangsu, start with pizza to share and the pasta sauces each person enjoys. At Hongdae Hwaduk Pizza, compare half-and-half pizza with cream, tomato and oil-based pasta. Before ordering for children, check ingredients and spice levels; ask about high-chair availability before visiting.

Choosing a pizza to share

For cheese-led flavours, consider Quattro Formaggi with Gorgonzola, cream cheese, Reggiano and mozzarella. For varied toppings, look at Quattro Stagioni; if tastes differ, compare the available half-and-half combinations. Choose quantities according to appetites and how you want to share, rather than treating these examples as a fixed family set.

Pasta and children’s dishes

Compare Gamberi Crema for spicy cream with shrimp and mushrooms, Pomodoro for tomato, cheese and basil, or Gamberi e Rucola for shrimp and arugula in an oil-based sauce. Before ordering for children, ask about ingredients and heat rather than judging suitability from the dish name alone.

High-chair availability

High chairs are available. If you need one, contact the restaurant when booking or before visiting to check availability for your time.

The dining space and walking route

Browse the actual dining-room photos to see the space. The address is 5 Dongmak-ro 7-gil, Mapo-gu, Seoul, ground floor. Allow about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong Exit 6 or Sangsu Exit 1, or about fifteen minutes from Hongik University Station. Share the directions guide with your family.

Checking your family reservation

Open the restaurant’s Naver Place page and select Reservation. Check your date, time and party size; contact the restaurant if the party size is not available online or you have seating questions. Use the same Place page for the latest menu and prices.

Planning a Christmas family meal

For a Christmas family meal, consider the dishes, any high-chair needs, and your preferred date and time together. High chairs are available, but check with the restaurant before visiting if you need one; availability at your chosen time is not guaranteed.

Christmas Eve and Christmas Day

For Christmas Eve or Christmas Day, open the restaurant’s Naver Place page and select its reservation button to check your date, time and party size, along with the latest operating information. If your date or party size cannot be selected, contact the restaurant.
